lava-river-cave.note: FR 171, the access road from FR 245 to the Lava River Cave trailhead, is closed to motorized vehicles for maintenance starting July 13, 2026; reaching the cave requires hiking or biking a longer unpaved approach. Source: Coconino National Forest (Forest Order 03-04-08-26-02).

south-kaibab-ooh-aah.note: Heat safety advisory: Grand Canyon National Park is urging visitors to avoid Inner Canyon trails between 10am and 4pm, when canyon temperatures regularly exceed 109 degrees. South Kaibab Trail is fully sun-exposed with no water source, and several heat-related hiker deaths have occurred on Inner Canyon trails this summer. Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park.

bright-angel-indian-garden.note: Heat safety advisory: Grand Canyon National Park is urging visitors to avoid Inner Canyon trails between 10am and 4pm, when canyon temperatures regularly exceed 109 degrees. Several heat-related hiker deaths have occurred on Inner Canyon trails this summer, including on Bright Angel Trail. Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park.

north-kaibab-coconino.note: Stage 3 Water Restrictions remain in effect on the North Rim following an April 2026 pipeline break; all North Rim potable water is off, including Supai Tunnel, Manzanita Day Use Area, and Cottonwood Campground, so hikers must carry all water needed for the entire trail. Bottled water is sold at the North Rim General Store, 9am to 4pm daily, but not on the trail itself. A separate hard closure of the trail between Redwall Bridge and Cottonwood Campground for waterline rehabilitation is scheduled to begin October 16, 2026, ending traditional rim-to-rim hiking. Grand Canyon National Park is also urging hikers to avoid Inner Canyon trails between 10am and 4pm due to dangerously hot conditions after several heat-related deaths this summer, including on North Kaibab Trail. Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park.
